programme.desc: Weird And Wonderful. Nigel explores why the most unlikely combinations can sometimes be the best. He creates an extraordinary bread and butter pudding made with exotic spice. S1, Ep8

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: All In One. Ree wants to make cooking simple and quick. She shares one-pot recipes like the lemon, basil and shrimp risotto, mouth-watering ramen pho and Greek salad in a jar. S16, Ep1

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: All In A Morning's Work. Ree fixes up a hearty lunch for the hardworking crew. She makes chunky beef chilli, unbelievably cheesy quesadillas and individual caramel cakes for dessert. S16, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Fishcakes, Linguine, Lamb Chops. Jamie Oliver cooks up quick Asian fishcakes with a sweet and spicy glaze. Then, he serves up lemon and courgette linguine and sticky lamb chops. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Lamb, Spaghetti, Fish, Cookies. Jamie cooks tender lamb shoulder with an easy cheat for maximum flavour. Plus, he prepares his speedy veggie spaghetti and apple crumble cookies. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Like A Pro: Holiday Brunch. Ina assembles a gorgeous seasonal brunch. On the menu are morning glory muffins, a fresh fruit platter, shakshuka with feta, and a spicy bloody Mary. S17, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Cook Like A Pro Pork. Ina Garten shares inventive ways to cook with pork. On the menu are sausage strudels, butternut squash and herbed pork tenderloins. S17, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: In Chocolate Week, and the bakers face a deceptively simple traybake signature. There's a chocolate and nut-filled technical and a white chocolate showstopper. S11, Ep4

programme.title: Classic Mary Berry
programme.desc: Mary Berry shares her simple but impressive recipes. On the menu is a delicious bacon and avocado salad, breakfast scones and a classic kedgeree. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: Bergen. Paul Hollywood is in Bergen to learn more about Norwegian baking. He meets a local family who teach him how to bake traditional national treats and creates his own version. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Henry Dimbleby. Food campaigner Henry Dimbleby joins Prue to explain how he convinced Michelin-starred chefs to work in school kitchens. John fishes for dinner. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Traditional Dishes. Guy Fieri checks out classic meals. In Baltimore, a shack steams crabs with corn on the cob and in Memphis, a woman recreates her mum's Southern favourites. S4, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Doin' Their Own Thing. Guy Fieri visits eateries doing things their own way, from Mexican specialities in a Salt Lake City joint to a Chicago diner serving seafood 16 different ways. S4, Ep13
